[Intro]
[G]
[Em]
[G]
[Em]

[Verse 1]
[G]Into the distance
a ribbon of black
[Em]Stretched to the point of no
turning back
[G]A flight of fancy on a
windswept field
[Em]Standing alone my
senses reeled
[G]A fatal attraction is
holding me fast How can
[Em]I escape this irre-
sistible grasp?

[Chorus]
[C]Can't keep my eyes from the cir-
[Am]cling skies
[F]Tongue tied and twisted just an
[C]earth bound [D]misfit, I

[Solo 1]
[G]
[Em]

[Verse 2]
[G]Ice is forming on the
tips of my wings
[Em]Unheeded warnings I
thought I thought of everything
[G]No navigator to find
my way home
[Em]Unladened, empty and turned
to stone

[Chorus]
[C]A soul in tension that's
[Am]learning to fly
[F]Condition grounded but deter-
[C]mined to try
Can't keep my eyes from the cir-
[Am]cling skies
[F]Tongue tied and twisted just an
[C]earth bound [D]misfit, I

[Bridge]
[F]
[Am]
[D]

[Verse 3]
[G]Above the planet on a
wing and a prayer,
[Em]My grubby halo, a va-
por trail in the empty air,
[G]Across the clouds I see my
shadow fly
[Em]Out of the corner of my
watering eye
[G]A dream unthreatened by the
morning light
[Em]Could blow this soul right through the roof
of the night

[Chorus]
[C]There's no sensation to com-
[Am]pare with this Suspend-
[F]ed animation, a
[C]state of bliss
Can't keep my mind from the cir-
[Am]cling skies
[F]Tongue tied and twisted just an
[C]earth bound [D]misfit, I

[Solo 2]
[G]
[Em]
[G]
[Em]
[G]
[Em]

title: Learning To Fly
